baseModel.note: Identical base and revision to run-1a/1b; the dataset is the only experimental variable.

prompt.note: Identical recipe to run-1a and run-1b, per the rebalance-not-redesign directive. The dataset is the only variable.

dataset.splitUnit: semantic scenario family; run-1a and run-1b family assignments pinned via splits-run1a-pinned.json and splits-run1b-pinned.json
dataset.targets: mandatory-clarify density; epistemic x mandatory-clarify composition; contrastive question discipline (silent optional vs fired mandatory) — while holding run-1b's gains without further overweighting them

evaluation.principalQuestion: Can the renderer learn when a question is required without regressing into automatic question-asking, and does increased density of both component behaviors improve unseen composition?
heldOut: run-1a unseen family (epistemic x superseded) — permanent regression set
run-1b unseen families (u1b-epimq, u1b-cuoq) — their composition classes entered run-1c training; now the key WITHIN-CLASS generalization measure
new held-out compositions authored before run-1c training (unseen/run1c-*): agreement x correction-user, correction-user x palette — pairs selected by sha256(freeze-run1b.json)

gates.clr: not worse than run-1b on validation (same-set comparison across all four arms)
gates.questionDiscipline: the target of this run: mandatory-clarify validation failures strictly below run-1b's; question-asking rate on question=none validation scenarios must not rise above run-1b's
gates.u1bComposition: u1b-epimq (failed 5/6 at run-1b) must improve now that the class is trained; u1b-cuoq must not regress from 6/6
gates.fidelity: >= run-1b on every check class; MustState omission = 0 on fixtures and validation
gates.paletteContamination: fixtures palette hits must hold at run-1b's 0; validation palette-class failures must not rise
gates.inventedExperience: 0 tolerated on the no-invented-experience validation families and the epcot-pizza fixture
gates.naturalness: blind review vs run-1b and base; must not lose would-use rate to run-1b
gates.latencyVram: within 10% of run-1b through the same serving stack
gates.generalization: new pre-registered unseen families CLR <= 2x validation CLR
